## Why

Describe the problem and observable outcome. Link the related Issue or approved
Spec when applicable; use `Refs #N` for incomplete work.

## Changes

Summarize the scope and any compatibility impact.

## Testing

Record the checked commit, OS/toolchain, commands, and actual
`PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN` results. Include `python3 scripts/verify.py` and list
ignored model/device checks separately. State relevant failure regressions.

## Risks and remaining acceptance

Describe material behavior, privacy, audio, model, or distribution risks.
Identify acceptance not yet performed and any required follow-up. Do not claim
that software CI establishes physical-device or release readiness.

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and preserved unrelated work.
- [ ] Authored content is English and contains no private recordings, logs, or credentials.
- [ ] Behavior changes include the relevant regression and failure coverage.
- [ ] Results describe this candidate; unperformed checks remain explicit.
